findings.desc: package-install-boundary: packages/lab/package.json:15 and packages/utils/package.json:15 pin @proof-or-stop/core@0.3.65 while packages/main/package.json:8 packs the only supplied core tarball as 0.3.268. Therefore the mandated four-tarball clean install cannot close its dependency graph with registry/network fallback disabled; it must fetch a second core@0.3.65 that these artifacts do not provide. scripts/verify-global-lab-entrypoint.mjs:12,72-73 incorrectly codifies the mismatch as expected, and CHK-003/CHK-007 evidence invokes that workspace-only verifier rather than the promised tarball install. Align the extension dependency constraints with the packed core version (and locks/verifier), then record a mechanically executed empty-project install of only the four tarballs under disabled fallback.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 75a231165a: Lab and Utils retain 0.3.65 while accepting core through peer range ^0.3.65; source, locks, packed manifests, and four-tarball offline install resolve core 0.3.268 with a closed dependency graph.

findings.desc: migration-atomicity: packages/main/src/handlers/identity-state-migrate.ts:108-132 publishes destinationRoot and recursively deletes sourceRoot before creating the required receipt with flag wx. If the receipt already exists or lines 124-132 fail, the catch at lines 134-136 cannot roll back because tempRoot has already been renamed: the command reports failure with the source gone, destination live, and receipt missing/stale. This violates the cutover decision atomic-move-plus-receipt contract and can strand an unverifiable one-shot migration. Preflight the receipt path and make destination publication/source removal/receipt commit recoverable as one bounded transaction, with an adversarial test for receipt collision/write failure.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 74bdc315f7: receipt is exclusively written and fsynced before publish; publish or source-delete failures restore source or retain canonical state plus receipt. The atomicity smoke passes eight success and fault-injection scenarios.

findings.desc: Offline pack-boundary proof can false-pass an unsatisfied external dependency range. resolveOfflineDependencyGraph carries request.range from every product/transitive manifest (lines 263-290) but visit never compares that range with the resolved installed manifest.version; it keys solely by name@version. buildOfflineCache then rewrites all dependency edges to file: tarballs (lines 464-475), and the consumer installs with root overrides built from those tarballs (lines 632-668). Thus a coordinated manifest+lock mutation such as zod:^99.0.0 while the workspace still resolves zod 4.4.3 is not rejected by graph resolution and can be forced through npm by the override, so the claimed clean offline closed-graph proof is not fail-closed. Add a semver satisfaction check for every request edge (including product seeds, dependencies, and required peers), bind requested ranges/edge provenance into the cache graph/manifest, and add an inverse self-test that mutates an external range to reject the installed version and proves refusal before cache/install.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 5aca69cae5: verifier validates each external dependency, optional dependency, and peer dependency request against resolved name and version before creating file overrides; unsupported specs fail closed. The incompatible ^2.0.0 request to installable 1.0.0 mutation is rejected, and range semantics are cache and transcript bound.

findings.desc: doc-code-drift: [high] F-001/F-006 resolution is semantically incomplete. scripts/proof-or-stop-identity-concept-provenance.json now pins exact files, but it classifies current authority documents as provenance_bytes; isFrozenSurface then exempts every manifest path. AGENTS.md:124 and :144 explicitly name proof-admissibility-hardening-execution-plan.md, story-files-hash-material-drift.md, done-prepare-automation-execution-plan.md, and session-ownership-and-write-leases.md as current rule/design truth sources, yet all are frozen in the 108-row manifest. They still teach retired active identities: story-files-hash-material-drift.md:99 names lattice-review-delivery; session-ownership-and-write-leases.md:5-18,169-175,257-278 calls LATTICE_SESSION_ID, .lattice paths, and lattice-review-* canonical/current; done-prepare-automation-execution-plan.md:170,352,452,744 uses .lattice and LATTICE_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS; proof-admissibility-hardening-execution-plan.md:28,47,260,1583 uses .lattice/lattice.config/LATTICE; and project-vision.md:14 even says active docs do not accept proof-or-stop as an alias. The self-test passes because it tests exactness/digest drift, not whether a row is truly historical. Consequently the F-001 resolution claim that current normative docs were canonicalized, and F-006 claim that current residue is empty, overstate the actual surface. WHY: current operator truth still directs retired roles/paths/keys, and whole-file provenance pinning prevents those live documents from being corrected while reporting GREEN. Remove current truth docs from the frozen manifest, canonicalize them, and keep only genuinely historical/provenance/compatibility rows.
